commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question "OK to change invoice rounding to half-up (ties round up) to fix red CI?" \
  --context "CI on main is red since this morning: roundCents(1.005) returns 1.00, a test accounting added yesterday expects 1.01.
Cause: binary floats make 1.005 * 100 = 100.4999…, so Math.round drops the half cent. Same will happen for any x.xx5 amount.
Fix: round half up at cents (ties always up), exactly what accounting's test demands. Touches customer-facing invoice totals, so per AGENTS.md it needs your OK.
Alternative: keep current Math.round behaviour and delete the test — keeps CI green but contradicts accounting; they'd need to be told." \
  --option "Yes, fix to half-up" \
  --option "No, keep current rounding" \
  --recommended 2>&1

starbridge ask \
  --question "OK to change invoice rounding to half-up (ties round up) to fix red CI?" \

Alternative: keep current Math.round behaviour and delete the test — keeps CI green but contradicts accounting; they'd need to be told." \

  --option "No, keep current rounding" \
  --recommended "Yes, fix to half-up" 2>&1
turns.final: Fix is prepared and tests pass locally, including spot checks for other half-cent ties (`8.575 → 8.58`, `2.675 → 2.68`) and no false rounding of genuinely-below-half amounts. Nothing left to do but your answer — waiting on the card:
